plot_summary: Tony Stark, who remembers his father as cold and distant, travels back in time and meets a younger version of him. Disguised, Tony has a conversation with his father, Howard, who is anxious about his own impending fatherhood. Through this interaction, Tony gains a new perspective, offering his father reassurance and finding a sense of closure. He thanks his father for everything he did, and the video culminates with an old recording of Howard expressing that his greatest creation is his son, Tony.
